title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): Design document reports with the updated Word add-in (New design components)
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 2 introduces new design components in the Word add-in for document reporting, allowing developers to create report layouts faster by inserting pre-built elements like addresses, field groups, amounts, signature lines, and notes with single clicks instead of manually building complex layouts.
key_points: The updated Word add-in for BC29 adds design components for common document parts: addresses, field groups, amounts, signature lines and notes.
Each component is inserted with a single click, which the author says RDLC layouts cannot do, so layout creation is much faster.
Install the latest Business Central add-in (version 3.0.0.0 rather than 2.0.4.0) from the Word Add-ins menu to get the Business Central ribbon tab.
Amounts components arrive with example figures to be replaced with data pane fields; signature lines are layout only, with no digital signing or encryption.
Notes components print free text of up to 10 lines on the report, unlike internal Business Central notes.

quotes.text: This dramatically speeds up layout creation for developers.
quotes.why_it_matters: Emphasizes the time-saving benefit of using pre-built design components in the updated Word add-in
